prompt: Run exactly one shell command, with the description "Run the build": sleep 15 && echo built. Do not think before calling it and do not write any text before the tool call.

steps.until: (?m)^● Running the build · \d+s *\n +⎿ +\$ sleep 15 && echo built \([3-9]s\)
(?m)^● Running the build · \d+s *\n +⎿ +\$ sleep 15 && echo built \((?:[7-9]|1[0-2])s\)
